title: 第6章 林照雪问案第5章 废剑第一招
lines: 天快亮时，沈照夜回到青岳剑院。
五两银子在怀里捂了一路，已经被血和汗浸得发潮。
药铺还没开门，檐下苦藤被晨风吹得轻响。
里面过了很久才有动静。
药铺管事披衣出来，刚要骂人，看见是沈照夜，脸上的不耐烦顿住。
这句话出口，他自己也意识到不对。
沈照夜把五两银子放在柜台上。
管事盯着银子，眼神变了。
管事伸手去拿银子，指尖却没有立刻收回。他看见沈照夜衣襟上有黑石矿灰，也看见他胸口怀里鼓起的一角。
管事脸上的笑僵了一下。
“我就问问。黑石矿栈旧物多，有些东西不好带回剑院，容易惹麻烦。”
管事没有再问，低头开柜。
沈照夜拿了药，转身要走。
“有些旧东西不是你能碰的。你父亲留下的麻烦，未必只在剑院。”
回头时，管事已经低头整理药柜，像刚才那句话不是他说的。
愿意说的人，不会只说半句。
content_en:
At dawn, Shen Zhaoye returned to Qingyue Sword Academy.
He did not return to his residence first.
Five taels of silver were covered in his arms, already soaked with blood and sweat.
Shen Shuang's medicine cannot wait.
The medicine shop is not open yet, and the vines under the eaves are rustling softly in the morning breeze.
Shen Zhaoye knocked on the door three times.
It took a long time before there was any movement inside.
The manager of the drug store put on his clothes and came out. Just as he was about to curse, he saw Shen Zhaoye, and the impatience on his face stopped.
"Are you still alive?"
When he said this, he realized that something was wrong.
Shen Zhaoye looked at him.
"Medicine."
The steward coughed: "Where's the money?"
Shen Zhaoye put five taels of silver on the counter.
The silver fell and the counter made a soft sound.
The drug store was quiet for a moment.
The steward stared at Yinzi and his eyes changed.
"Dark stone mine stack?"
"Yeah."
"They settle the money so quickly?"
Shen Zhaoye didn't answer.
The steward reached out to pick up the silver, but his fingertips did not immediately withdraw. He saw black stone ash on Shen Zhaoye's lapel, and also saw a bulge on his chest.
"Did you give anything else to the mine stack?"
Shen Zhaoye raised his eyes.
The smile on the steward's face froze.
"I'm just asking. There are a lot of old items in the Black Stone Ore Stack. Some of them are difficult to bring back to the Sword Academy and may cause trouble."
"Medicine."
The steward didn't ask any more questions and lowered his head to open the cupboard.
Two pills of Cold Dew Pill.
Warm pulse and take three pieces of powder.
A small packet of styptic powder.
He pushed the medicine bag over.
"These five taels can only cover part of the old debt."
"I know."
Shen Zhaoye took the medicine and turned to leave.
The steward suddenly lowered his voice.
"There are some old things that you can't touch. The trouble your father left behind may not only be in the Sword Academy."
Shen Zhaoye stopped.
When he turned around, the steward had already lowered his head to tidy up the medicine cabinet, as if the words just now were not his.
Shen Zhaoye did not ask further questions.
People who are willing to speak will not just speak half a sentence.
He sent the medicine back to the West Branch Hospital.
title_en: Chapter 6 Lin Zhaoxue Questions Chapter 5 The First Move of the Wasted Sword
